maya (PM): Quick sync — finalizing PRD for Observability Console (dashboards + traces + retention). Need concise acceptance criteria and a list of edge cases we must cover before launch. Can folks review?

jonathan (Eng): On it. Main perf concern: define load SLOs for dashboards. Proposal: cached initial load <800ms, cold load <2s. Also clarify trace pagination behavior. cc @samir

samir (SRE): Agree on SLOs. Edge case: tracing backend partial outage -> UI should show cached summary + persistent banner with timestamp and 'retry' CTA. Also retention edits should be validated against org-level max (prevent accidental infinite retention).

kelly (Design): I’ll add empty-state and error-state mocks. UX edge cases: org with 0 traces (show onboarding + upload sample) vs org with massive trace volume (show sampling toggle + summary counts up front). Will share variants.

lina (DevEx): Add acceptance criteria around event schema compatibility: events missing trace_id must be dropped and increment `invalid_trace_count` metric; SDK versions older than 1.2 should be flagged in ingestion logs.

carlo (CS): Customer ask to include an audit-friendly export: UI + API export of retention policies and the active sampling rules as CSV/JSON. This is a blocker for a compliance customer; recommend add to launch criteria.

jonathan (Eng): Draft checklist snippet to include in PRD:
```
- dashboard_load_cached_ms <= 800
- dashboard_load_cold_ms <= 2000
- trace_fetch_timeout <= 3s (per page)
- trace_pagination_consistent == true
- retention_policy_editable == true + export endpoint
- deprecated_sdk_flagging == true
```

maya (PM): +1 checklist. Please add any missing edge cases inline. I’ll fold this into the PRD and call for final review by EOD.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary deploy window tomorrow 06:00 UTC (service: observability-console).

samir (SRE): Another edge case: DB partial read-only mode — UI should surface 'stale data' state and allow user to request explicit refresh; no 500s to clients. Also retention rebalancing should not block writes.

kelly (Design): Small note: mobile/tablet layout — collapse long trace spans under concise summary to avoid huge DOM renders. Also provide skeletons for slow networks.

maya (PM): Thanks — I'll update the doc and add acceptance criteria + explicit edge-case examples (sample payloads) and link here: https://redwood.prd/docs/obs-prd-1769805123. Ping me if anything else to add.
